items.title: بيان من العامة للصوامع والتخزين (GSSC.CA) بخصوص ملخص قرارات مجلس إدارة الشركة
items.title_en: Statement from The General Company for Silos and Storage (GSSC.CA) regarding the summary of the company's board of directors resolutions
items.meaning: The board met and recorded decisions. What was decided is in the filing itself.
